title: How Reliable are AMR Parser Outputs? Uncertainty Estimation for AMR Parsing
abstract: arXiv:2610.13236v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Recent advances have significantly improved the performance of Abstract Meaning Representation (AMR) parsers, yet determining when their outputs can be trusted remains largely unexplored. This work presents the first study of uncertainty estimation for AMR parsers in a black-box setting using top-k beam-search candidates. Uncertainty is estimated from pairwise candidate similarities and evaluated using the Prediction Rejection Ratio. This work characterises the relationship between parsing performance and uncertainty, evaluates the reliability of beam candidate distributions, analyses the effect of evaluation metrics on uncertainty assessment, and identifies parsers that provide the strongest balance between performance and reliability. Experimental results show the value of uncertainty estimation as a complementary dimension for evaluating AMR parsers.

translated_title: AMR解析器的输出有多可靠？面向AMR解析的不确定性估计
translated_abstract: 近期的进展显著提升了抽象意义表示（AMR）解析器的性能，然而判断其输出何时可以被信任这一问题在很大程度上仍未被探索。本工作首次在黑盒设置下，利用top-k束搜索候选结果对AMR解析器开展不确定性估计研究。不确定性通过成对候选相似度来估计，并使用预测拒绝率进行评估。本工作刻画了解析性能与不确定性之间的关系，评估了束候选分布的可靠性，分析了评估指标对不确定性评估的影响，并识别出在性能与可靠性之间实现最佳平衡的解析器。实验结果表明，不确定性估计作为评估AMR解析器的补充维度具有重要价值。
tldr: 该论文首次在黑盒设置下研究AMR解析器的不确定性估计，通过束搜索候选间的相似度来评估解析输出的可靠性，为AMR解析器的评估提供了性能之外的重要补充维度。
en_tdlr: This paper presents the first study of uncertainty estimation for AMR parsers in a black-box setting, using beam-search candidate similarities to assess output reliability, offering a valuable complementary dimension for evaluating AMR parsers beyond performance alone.
